The project

The story behind it.

The initiative

This work reflects Khadija's core professional philosophy: accurate, credible and ethical information is a fundamental human right, and a structural lifeline during humanitarian emergencies.

What she does

Using Communication for Development (C4D) frameworks, Khadija bridges the gap between fragile communities, international NGOs and governments, including the Tunisian and Algerian governments.

In Syria, she works with the Ministry of Information on audience research, digital media literacy and public-interest storytelling.
